title: Rolling Sea
line: Every wave is the same wave, arriving.
alt: Sketch in woodblock-print style: bands of curling indigo waves with foam beads roll to the right under a red sun and a snow-capped peak, and a boat of rowers rides the swell.

title: Bamboo Wind
line: You only see the wind by what it bends.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: black and grey bamboo stalks with clusters of brush-stroke leaves bend and sway in gusts of wind on cream rice paper, with a red seal in the corner.

title: Orrery
line: Draw the heavens carefully enough and they start to turn.
alt: Sketch of a blueprint: a planetary orrery drawn in white lines on blue grid paper, with orbit ellipses, a yellow sun, planets on arms, a gear train and dimension lines; the planets and gears turn.

title: Night City
line: Every lit window is somebody still awake.
alt: Sketch in risograph style: a blue and pink city skyline with yellow lit windows under a big yellow moon, a pink train crossing on an elevated line, and the city reflected in the river below.

title: Fiddlehead
line: It was holding all of this, rolled up small.
alt: Sketch of a cyanotype sun print: on a brushed field of Prussian blue, a pale fern fiddlehead unrolls into a tall frond beside grass stems and a small curled crozier.

title: Murmuration
line: Thousands of birds, and not one of them is in charge.
alt: Sketch in stipple: a dusk sky over reeds made of ink dots, with a rose-coloured low sun, and a vast flock of starlings shown as dots that flows into changing shapes.

title: Lamplight
line: Everything on the table leans away from the light.
alt: Sketch in etching style: a jug, two pears and a bowl on a table under a hanging lamp; the lamp swings and the cross-hatched shadows and pool of warm light move with it.

title: Sea Chart
line: The route is only ever the wake behind you.
alt: Sketch of an antique sea chart in sepia ink on stained vellum: islands with ripple lines, a compass rose, a sea serpent, and a small ship sailing a dotted red route around the islands.

title: Rain Window
line: The city dissolves, and the room gets warmer.
alt: Sketch in watercolour: a window at night between rose curtains, rain drops on the glass and blurred city lights beyond, with a potted plant and a steaming cup on the sill.

title: Snow Fox
line: Curled up small enough, the winter goes around you.
alt: Sketch as a black, red and cream linocut: a red fox curled asleep in snow below carved pine trees and a full moon with halo rings, with snow falling.

title: Aurora
line: The sky was drawing, and it would not hold still.
alt: Sketch in pastel on black paper: green and magenta curtains of aurora ripple above dark mountains and pines, reflected in a lake below a starry sky.

title: Jellyfish
line: It swims by closing its hand around the dark.
alt: Sketch in glowing pastel on black: three jellyfish in cyan, violet and pink pulse and drift in deep water, with long trailing tentacles and drifting particles.

title: Ring Dance
line: Nobody leads. Everybody holds on.
alt: Sketch in cut paper after Matisse: five red figures holding hands dance in a turning ring on a green hill against a deep blue sky with yellow and cream paper shapes.

title: Paper Theatre
line: The sea was cardboard. We went anyway.
alt: Sketch of a toy paper theatre: red curtains frame a night sea of layered teal paper waves with a paper sailing boat, a gold crescent moon and stars hanging on threads.

title: Truchet
line: Turn one tile and the whole path changes.
alt: Sketch in Bauhaus screen-print style: a grid of square tiles with black curved bands and red, yellow and blue quarter circles that rotate in waves, re-forming winding paths.

title: Four Beats
line: Every shape has its own way of hearing the same note.
alt: Sketch of a Kandinsky-style score: a yellow and blue ringed circle, a red triangle, a black zigzag, coloured dots, a blue arc, a chequerboard and violet rings on staff lines, each moving as a red playhead passes.

title: Moon Tides
line: A whole month in one breath of the sea.
alt: Sketch in art deco gold on black: a moon engraved with fine lines passes through its phases above rows of teal and gold scalloped waves, inside a stepped gold frame with rays and star sparkles.

title: Fire Mountain
line: The island is still being made.
alt: Sketch in risograph style: a teal volcano with orange lava streams smokes under a purple and orange sunset sky with a striped yellow sun, palm silhouettes in the foreground and a sea below.

title: Cyclist
line: Keep the line going and it takes you somewhere.
alt: Sketch in a single black line on white: a cyclist rides past rolling hills, bushes, telegraph poles and clouds under a red sun, drawn as one continuous pen line.

title: Koi
line: Two fish, one circle, no beginning.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: seen from above, a red and white koi and a black koi swim in a slow circle around each other among grey lily pads, with ripples on the water and a red seal.
